description: Source code for a multi-window OpenGL application using ANGLE, involving window creation, rendering, and transformations.

classes.name: MultiWindowSample
classes.description: A class managing multiple windows and rendering them with transformations, using ANGLE and OpenGL ES.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes windows, OpenGL program, and sets up initial state.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Cleans up resources, deletes OpenGL program.

methods.name: step
methods.description: Updates rotation and processes window messages.

methods.name: draw
methods.description: Renders all windows with transformations and swaps buffers.

methods.name: swap
methods.description: Overridden to do nothing, as buffer swapping is handled in draw().
